plugins.description: Nine Claude skills for intraday trading on the NSE: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a budget manager, a risk manager, an order ticket (nothing is ever sent to a broker) and price alerts.
